description.value:
For almost thirty centuries, your family has worked to keep order. Communication is the thread that holds civilization together: your ancestors settled the disputes of monarchs and helped the dragonmarked houses find their place in the world. Few realize how much House Sivis has shaped the present age, just as few know how often a royal adviser holds more power than the ruler. While the other houses fight for fame and recognition, House Sivis plays a long game of quiet influence behind the scenes, keeping order amid endless intrigue.

Ability Scores: Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.94dubELJF6Xf9xtI]{Mark of Scribing}

Skill Proficiencies: History and Perception

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCalligraph]{Calligrapher's Supplies}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCalligraph]{Calligrapher's Supplies}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInk00000000]{Ink}, 5 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInkPen00000]{Ink Pens}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPaper000000]{Paper} (30 sheets), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagParchment00]{Parchment} (9 sheets), 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP
